interpretation_policy: source requirements are distinct from conservative implementation gates

rules.scope: Standard flammable liquid; provisional packing-group logic
decision_thresholds: Physical state liquid; vapour pressure at 50 °C ≤300 kPa, not completely gaseous at 20 °C, 101.3 kPa
Closed-cup FP ≤60 °C
PG I if IBP ≤35 °C; otherwise PG II if FP<23 °C, PG III if FP≥23 °C
exceptions: Specific entry and mixed hazard prevalence override; viscosity concessions and Class 6.1 hazards need separate checks
indeterminate_if: Missing measurements; no verified liquid status; named entry/viscosity/other class incomplete
possible_outputs: criteria_not_met for standard FP pathway only

rules.scope: Carriage at or above flash point for liquid with FP>60 °C
decision_thresholds: FP>60 °C AND carried at/above FP: preliminary Class 3 heated-liquid indicator, candidate UN 3256
exceptions: Named entries, material state and carriage conditions must be independently verified
indeterminate_if: Uncertain elevated temperature or FP, material is not suitable for this pathway

decision_thresholds: Named products with 60<FP≤100 °C are included in Class 3, UN 1202
exceptions: Verify material identity and UN 1202 entry
indeterminate_if: Named-product evidence missing or not matched

decision_thresholds: Liquid desensitized explosive explicitly included within Class 3
exceptions: Entry-specific rules and prohibitions must be checked
indeterminate_if: Ambiguous identity or not independently assessed

rules.scope: Liquid with FP>35 °C that does not sustain combustion
decision_thresholds: FP>35 °C; documented UN MTC §32.2.5 no sustained combustion; not carried at/above FP
exceptions: Not applicable if heated to at/above FP; other classes still apply
indeterminate_if: Test method/provenance not provided or uncertain
possible_outputs: criteria_not_met for Class 3 FP pathway only

rules.scope: Direct oral, dermal, dust or mist toxic evidence, candidate PG
decision_thresholds: Oral LD50 mg/kg: PG I ≤5, II >5–50, III >50–300
Dermal LD50 mg/kg: PG I ≤50, II >50–200, III >200–1000
Dust/mist 1h LC50 mg/L: PG I ≤0.2, II >0.2–2, III >2–4
Dust/mist 4h LC50 ×4 for comparison to 1h criteria; most severe relevant route determines PG
exceptions: Tear gas PG II floor where otherwise PG III; Class 8 and 2.1.3.10 precedence and named entries
indeterminate_if: Missing toxicity route completeness or human-experience review, untested mixtures, unresolved priority

decision_thresholds: LC50 for 4h exposure ×2 to obtain 1h comparator
PG I: V≥10×LC50 and LC50≤1000ppm; PG II: V≥LC50 and LC50≤3000ppm (if not PG I); PG III: V≥0.2×LC50 and LC50≤5000ppm (if not PG I/II)
exceptions: Use Class 6.1 human review, mixture, priority and named-entry gates
indeterminate_if: V or exposure duration unknown; vapour form/class not established

decision_thresholds: PG I: exposure ≤3min with observed skin damage ≤60min
PG II: >3–≤60min, observed skin damage ≤14 days (20,160min)
PG III: >60–≤240min, damage observed ≤14 days
Valid non-discriminating tier data can conservatively assign PG I or II per §2.2.8.1.5.2
exceptions: Skin data/human evidence precede metal and mixtures methodology differs
indeterminate_if: Study unsuitable, duration/observation unknown, other hazards or Table A unresolved

rules.scope: Metal corrosion when not corrosive to skin
decision_thresholds: Corrosion rate >6.25 mm/year at 55°C on steel OR aluminium -> PG III
exceptions: Actual UN MTC §37 test conditions/materials must be confirmed
indeterminate_if: One untested metal without positive result; tests not substantiated
possible_outputs: criteria_not_met only if both metals tested ≤6.25 AND skin non-corrosive

rules.scope: Aquatic substance environmental hazard, selected transport entry candidate
decision_thresholds: Acute 1: valid acute L/EC50 ≤1mg/L
Adequate chronic, nonrapid: Chronic 1 NOEC/ECx ≤0.1, Chronic 2 >0.1–≤1mg/L
Adequate chronic, rapid: Chronic 1 ≤0.01, Chronic 2 >0.01–≤0.1mg/L
Absent adequate chronic, use acute + nonrapid degradation or bioaccumulation (BCF≥500 / logKow≥4) per table
If no other class and no more specific entry: PG III; UN 3077 (solid)/3082 (liquid) candidate
exceptions: Mixture M factors/summation, chronic reliability, metals, special provisions not implemented; secondary environment mark may apply when other class
indeterminate_if: Mixture or incomplete data; other class not excluded; named entries not checked
possible_outputs: criteria_met candidate PG III and UN entry

rules.scope: Elevated-temperature substance without another hazard class
required_inputs: flash_point_c or verified no flash point for liquid
decision_thresholds: Liquid ≥100 °C and below flash point (if any) => UN 3257 candidate
Solid ≥240 °C => UN 3258 candidate
Only if not classifiable in other classes
exceptions: If liquid carried at/above flash point, refer to Class 3 heated carriage; named entries may supersede
indeterminate_if: Other class not excluded, FP unknown, unsupported state/temperature

decision_thresholds: Unsupported battery/articles/PCB/asbestos/substance types do not enter this limited rule set
exceptions: Further Class 9 modules and DGL needed
